key_insight: Multifidelity Operator Inference combines scarce high-fidelity data with abundant coarse-model data to reduce variance in learned reduced-order models.
engineering_relevance: More accurate, inexpensive PDE surrogates can support repeated simulations for uncertainty quantification and engineering design under limited training budgets.
method: Learn reduced operators non-intrusively from state snapshots and corresponding time derivatives.
Supplement high-fidelity snapshots with data from coarser discretizations of the same problem.
Estimate reduced operators using multifidelity linear regression.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments on model PDE problems show more accurate solution-field predictions than high-fidelity-only Operator Inference at the same computational budget.
watch_item: Results are demonstrated on model PDEs; effectiveness for complex engineering systems and different coarse discretizations remains to be established.
paper_title: Multifidelity Operator Inference for Non-intrusive Model Reduction under Data Scarcity
